the exploration of a new design methodology for the H.264 video decoding system.
the system level design methodology and the design space exploration on the configurable hardware-software co-design for H264 video decoder.
the exploration of the system architecture for H.264 decoder and the design of a configurable HW/SW architecture.

this work has proposed a flexible and efficient architecture design for H.264 decoder.
